Interface OrderApi

public interface OrderApi
Reads and creates orders.

Every future completes off the main thread; see CompaniesApi for how to get back onto it. Orders are anonymous towards players: never show the owner of an order to the company working on it, or the company to the owner.

    • create

      CompletableFuture<CreateOrderResult> create(OrderRequest request)
      Creates an order, the same way /order create does.

      A PreOrderCreateEvent with the source API is fired on the main thread before anything is charged; its listeners may change or cancel the order. After the order was saved an OrderCreatedEvent follows.

      See OrderRequest.charge() for who pays for the order and OrderRequest.respectLimits() for the limits that apply. A rule the order breaks completes the future with a rejection, not exceptionally.

      This is a write operation: before Companies is ready the future completes exceptionally with an ApiNotReadyException.

      Parameters:
      request - order to create
      Returns:
      future of the created order or the reason it was not created
